expected_version_source: database of the SOLIDWORKS 2025 data root found beside the configured one
message: SOLIDWORKS 2025 expects Hole Wizard database 28.00, but the configured database is 29.01. Hole Wizard database 29.01 is incompatible with expected 28.00.
remediation_owner: environment owner: select the SOLIDWORKS 2025 data root in Tools > Options > System Options > Hole Wizard/Toolbox. The pipeline does not change it.
user_action: Point SOLIDWORKS 2025 to the company-approved 2025 Hole Wizard/Toolbox data folder (Tools > Options > System Options > Hole Wizard/Toolbox), restart SOLIDWORKS, then rerun preflight.
